# Motion Woods Private Limited

> Pune-based wooden door and furniture manufacturer for residential, commercial and institutional projects. Built on founder Diwakar R. Vishwakarma's 35+ years of woodworking through his proprietorship firm Diwakar Furniture — including 7,650+ doors delivered across just two townships, with 20+ key builder clients in Pune. Operates a 12,000 sq ft factory at Nere, near Punawale.

## Company Facts
- Legal name: Motion Woods Private Limited (also written Motion.Woods)
- Registered office: Hadapsar, Pune – 411028, Maharashtra, India
- Factory: 12,000 sq ft manufacturing unit at Nere, near Punawale, Pune, Maharashtra
- Phone: +91 98607 85024 / +91 94235 81923
- Email: admin@motionwoods.com
- Website: https://www.motionwoods.com
- Leadership: Diwakar R. Vishwakarma (Director & Founder), Pramodkumar R. Gupta (Director), Anshu Diwakar Vishwakarma (CEO)
- Heritage: Founder Diwakar R. Vishwakarma brings 35+ years of woodworking experience; his proprietorship firm Diwakar Furniture's team, machinery and processes now power Motion Woods.

## Services
- Wooden door manufacturing & installation (teak, veneer, laminate, flush, WPC, acoustic, hospital, classroom): https://www.motionwoods.com/wooden-door-manufacturer-pune
- Furniture manufacturing (residential, office, institutional): https://www.motionwoods.com/furniture-manufacturer-pune
- Interior furnishing (offices, bungalows, apartments): https://www.motionwoods.com/interior-furnishing-contractor-pune
- On-site carpentry & custom work (kitchens, staircases, mandirs, paneling): https://www.motionwoods.com/carpentry-contractor-pune
- Wood polishing & finishing (PU, Melamine, Duco): https://www.motionwoods.com/wood-polishing-finishing-pune
- Bulk door contracts for builders & townships with on-site manufacturing: https://www.motionwoods.com/builder-door-supplier-pune

## Track Record (delivered under the Diwakar Furniture legacy)
- Roshan Milestone, Tathawade (Roshan Realty): 3150+ doors, 1800+ frames, 661 apartments, 8 towers, completed in 1.5 years with on-site machinery
- Yashada Splendid Park I & II, Moshi-Alandi (Yashada Realty): 4500+ doors, 2650+ frames, 950 apartments, 9 towers, 2 years
- Park Street township, Wakad (Pride Purple Group): 65%+ of all door shutter & frame work
- ₹2 Cr luxury bungalow interior, Undri: 8 bedrooms, 6 months
- Kritija Construction corporate office: full carpentry, polish & painting
- Clients include: Pride Purple Group, Yashada Realty, Roshan Realty, VTP Realty, Gera Developments, Bhate & Raje Construction, Kritija Construction, Kalpataru, Goel Ganga, Solitaire Group, Mantra Majestique
